steps.note: Open the eRFX project creation screen.
Enable eRFX project creation for the test.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation.
Set the project title required for publishing.
Configure the project with an RFQ-only stage.
Configure the RFQ stage.
Apply the available RFQ pricing template.
Add the requested cylinder product with quantity 10.
Populate the RFQ pricing sheet so the line item is ready for publishing.
Set the requested delivery location for the line item.

args.goal: On the buyer's RFQ create screen, open Add T&Cs, add the clauses "Payment within 45 days" and "Delivery within 7 days", leave both clause modes as None, leave "Mark all Terms & Conditions mandatory" unticked, click Done, and stop when the saved project-level terms are visible.

steps.note: Add the two optional project-level clauses, which have no dedicated catalog action.
Invite one QA test vendor for the vendor-side submission.
Commit the 30-minute event schedule.
Publish the RFQ project.
Confirm the event reached its published project page.
Open the invited vendor's supplier portal session.
Open the event's RFQ pricing round in the vendor portal.
Confirm the first project-level clause is shown to the vendor.
Confirm the second project-level clause is shown to the vendor.
Accept the available terms as part of quote submission and submit a quote of 100.
Verify the vendor's quote was submitted.
Return to the buyer's event page.
Confirm the buyer sees the vendor response on the RFQ stage.
